configuration.title: Fix for Claude Code's New-Tab Auto-Splitting

claudeAutoSplitFix.enabled.description: Move a newly opened Claude Code tab into the preceding editor group when Claude creates a new split for it.

claudeAutoSplitFix.moveFileTabs.description: Also move a file that opens alone in a brand-new editor group — the layout Claude Code's sidebar file links produce — back into the previous group. Never touched: a file already open in another group, a document that just closed elsewhere (a drag), and non-file schemes (virtual documents). Turn this off if you deliberately open not-yet-open files into new splits (Open to the Side, Go to Definition to the Side, dragging from the Explorer): the tab API cannot tell those apart from a Claude file link.

claudeAutoSplitFix.restoreDelayMs.description: Delay before correcting Claude's editor-group placement. Increase this if Claude recreates or relocks the split. Applies to Claude conversation tabs only; plain file tabs use a fixed short settle instead.

claudeAutoSplitFix.diagnostics.description: Record tab and group events in the Claude Auto-Split Fix output channel.
